caption:
Slab, beam aur column dhalai ke liye best hai VAJRA PP shuttering sheet.

Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur concrete finish aati hai bilkul smooth. Har dhalai ka kharcha ply se kam padta hai.

Apne thekedar aur mistri bhai ke saath share karein.
